name: @toolplane/python-adapters
description: Thin ToolGuard Python framework adapters for LangGraph and CrewAI.

scripts.lint: python3 -m ruff check toolguard_adapters tests && python3 -m black --check toolguard_adapters tests
scripts.test:coverage: python3 -m coverage run -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m coverage report --fail-under=80
